naming: Formation names at the name level: filed spellings are joined only where they differ formally or where the filings put both at the same depth in the same townships.
units: metres from origin; z is metres relative to sea level, negative down, for tops, paths and ground alike
datum: Each well hangs from the elevation filed with its own formation tops. Where none was usable the USGS 3DEP ground under the well is used instead, and the well says so.
measured_only: Every point is a filed measurement. No surface is drawn between wells because nothing was measured there.
layout: wells: parallel arrays by well index, op indexing operators. tops: per formation index, the well index, filed depth in feet and elevation in metres of each top. paths: surveyed wells, as flat x,y,z triples. multi: wells completed in more than one formation, by well index. Coordinates are whole metres.

elevation_check.note: Filed elevation minus USGS 3DEP ground under the well, metres, for wells hung from a filed elevation.
